Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Install 1Password CLI

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Use the command below or the official guide.

text.font-family: Geist Mono Variable, Noto Sans CJK JP, monospace
Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Connect it to 1Password

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Settings → Developer → Integrate with CLI.

text.font-family: Geist Mono Variable, Noto Sans CJK JP, monospace
Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Press “Scan now”

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Approve with Windows Hello or Touch ID.

svg.text: Opening it on a Mac for the first time

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: The app is not notarized by Apple yet, so macOS stops it at first. Go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and press “Open Anyway”.

svg.text: Safety you can check

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Every line is public. We decided what the app must never do, and the code enforces it.

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Passwords, usernames and notes are never shown, stored or sent anywhere

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: The leak check sends only the first 5 characters of a password's hash

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: New passwords are created inside 1Password and never passed as command arguments

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Cleanup only moves items to the Archive. Nothing is permanently deleted

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Copied passwords clear after 30 seconds and stay out of clipboard history

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: AI apps can only ask. Nothing runs until you approve it on screen

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Questions

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Is it free?

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Yes. Only the email breach check needs a paid

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Have I Been Pwned key, and it is optional.

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Are my passwords sent anywhere?

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: No. The leak check sends only the first 5 characters

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: of each password's hash.

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Is this made by 1Password?

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: No. It is an unofficial app that works through

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: the official 1Password CLI.

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: What if I archive something by mistake?

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Items are moved to the Archive, never deleted,

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: so you can restore them in the 1Password app.

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: What if the site won't accept the change?

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Press “Restore old password” and 1Password

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: goes back to the old one.

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: What about logins with a passkey?

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Restoring would remove the passkey, so the app

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: asks first. Restore from 1Password's history instead.

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: macOS won't open it

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: It is not notarized yet. Go to System Settings →

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Privacy & Security and press “Open Anyway”.

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Can it scan automatically?

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Yes. Pick daily, weekly or monthly. It scans in

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: the background and tells you only about new issues.

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Free, starting tonight.

text.font-family: Geist Variable, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Nothing is deleted, only moved to the Archive. Changed passwords can be restored.
